title: Spellwarden settings (.spellwarden/config.yml)
description: Optional. Unknown keys and a version other than 1 are errors (exit 2). probe-private is deliberately not a key.

include.description: Globs on scan-root-relative POSIX paths; ** matches across directories. Empty means every file.

connected.description: Connected mode (needs scanner 1.2.0 or later; older scanners refuse the file). pack and required are the repository's statement: no flag, no environment variable, and on a pull or merge request they are read from the base revision.

pack.description: A pack id (baseline or 32 hex), optionally @version (N.N), from the organisation's allowed list.

upload.description: Upload results in CI. Default true. --upload, --no-upload and SPELLWARDEN_UPLOAD override it.

required.description: A run that cannot connect exits 2 instead of falling back to free mode. Default false.
